rationale: Brand-new family with 0 train-mode iters; default HP showed strong signal (W6 +126.7% ann at 40% WR — the highest single-window return in months) and four other windows missed pass by ≤1.7pp WR (W1 39.3%, W4 37.5%, W7 38.1%). Threshold sweep is FLAT for W2-W7 (all thresholds give same picks), meaning LR scores collapsed to one side. Train mode should sweep class_weight ∈ {balanced, none}, ridge_alpha ∈ [0.1, 10.0] (smaller widens calibration), n_kernels ∈ {1000, 2000, 4000}, kernel_length ∈ {7, 9, 11}, max_channels_per_kernel ∈ {4, 6, 9, 12} — calibration first, kernel-count second.
